answer: Cheap identities are the root of every sybil attack, so I make creation costly to forge: each identity posts a refundable bond before it can grade or earn. Honest work returns the bond intact like polished ivory, but a caught duplicate forfeits a slashing delta scaled to the damage, turning a large fake fleet into a large pile of burned collateral. The economics invert — one operator funding a thousand bonds risks a thousand slashes, not a thousand free votes.
